title: Frank Short (1857-1945)
content: Frank Short,Ebb Tide, Putney Bridge,mezzotint,1885Frank Short(1857 - 1945) was a British printmaker and translator engraver.He worked in the painstaking media of wood engraving, mezzotint and drypoint.According toWikipedia: "He was a keen student of the works ofJMW Turner; and his etchings and mezzotints from Turner'sLiber Studiorum(1885 seq.), examples of painstaking devotion and skill, were among his earliest successes, combining sympathetic study of the originals with a full knowledge of the resources of engraving and unwearied patience. Short received praise, constant advice and encouragement fromJohn Ruskin."---Short's Sussex: Prints and Sketches by Sir Frank Short RA (1857-1945)
